title: Foundry Artifact Request v1
description: Structural schema for the FULL request Foundry conceptually receives. This is a SUPERSET of specs/alchemist/v1/artifact-request.schema.json, which remains authoritative for the minimal shape (artifactType, options, required) as embedded conceptually inside CompilationInput. Foundry's version adds orchestration-context fields Alchemist would attach before handing a request to Foundry. Do not treat this as redefining artifactType/options/required — their meaning is identical to the Alchemist schema. See docs/bible/09-foundry/193-artifact-request-contract.md.

requestId.description: PLANNED — no current request carries a distinct ID; see docs/bible/08-alchemist/163-compilation-input-contract.md's same finding for requestContext.

artifactType.description: Identical vocabulary to specs/alchemist/v1/artifact-request.schema.json, minus PREVIEW_MESH — Foundry owns production/technical artifacts; preview belongs to Vision (see docs/bible/09-foundry/192-artifact-domain-model.md).

requestedBy.description: PLANNED — no request-attribution concept exists; this system has no user-account model.

sourceCompilationId.description: PLANNED — see docs/bible/08-alchemist/171-compilation-result-model.md's compilationId field, also PLANNED.

sourceDefinitionHash.description: CURRENT, implicit — every export request carries modelId, which equals definitionHash.

includeComponents.description: PLANNED — no current request can select individual components; only whole-artifact requests (with the single includeStoneReference toggle) exist.

outputPreferences.description: PLANNED — no current output-format preference (e.g. ASCII vs. binary STL) is configurable.
